question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The manager said to the employee, 'Why did you not attend the meeting yesterday?'
options: The manager asked the employee why he had not attended the meeting the previous day.
The manager asked the employee why had he not attended the meeting the previous day.
The manager asked the employee why he did not attend the meeting yesterday.
The manager asked the employee that why he had not attended the meeting the day before.
answer: The manager asked the employee why he had not attended the meeting the previous day.
explanation: चरण 1: Reporting verb 'said to' को 'asked' में बदलें। चरण 2: Inverted commas हटाकर Wh- word 'why' को conjunction बनाएँ (that का प्रयोग न करें)। चरण 3: Past Indefinite (did) को Past Perfect (had + V3) में बदलें। चरण 4: 'yesterday' को 'the previous day' में बदलें और वाक्य को Assertive (Subject + Verb) बनाएँ।
trick: Indirect speech में प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य साधारण बन जाता है, इसलिए 'why had he' गलत है, 'why he had' सही है।
tip: Wh-word के बाद Subject + Verb का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The doctor said to the patient, 'Do not eat anything heavy before the surgery tomorrow.'
options: The doctor ordered the patient not to eat anything heavy before the surgery tomorrow.
The doctor advised the patient to not eat anything heavy before the surgery the next day.
The doctor advised the patient not to eat anything heavy before the surgery the next day.
The doctor advised the patient that he should not eat anything heavy before the surgery the following day.
answer: The doctor advised the patient not to eat anything heavy before the surgery the next day.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'advised' (सलाह) में बदलें। चरण 2: Negative imperative में 'Do not' को हटाकर 'not to' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'tomorrow' को 'the next day' या 'the following day' में बदलें।
trick: 'to not eat' एक स्प्लिट इन्फिनिटिव एरर (split infinitive error) है, हमेशा 'not to eat' सही होता है।
tip: Negative imperative में हमेशा 'not to + V1' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said, 'Alas! I have lost my grandmother's gold ring.'
options: She exclaimed with sorrow that she had lost her grandmother's gold ring.
She exclaimed with sorrow that she has lost her grandmother's gold ring.
She exclaimed sadly that she lost her grandmother's gold ring.
She exclaimed with regret that I had lost my grandmother's gold ring.
answer: She exclaimed with sorrow that she had lost her grandmother's gold ring.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Alas!' दुख दर्शाता है, इसलिए 'exclaimed with sorrow' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Conjunction 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 3: First person pronoun 'I' को subject (She) के अनुसार 'she' में बदलें। चरण 4: Present Perfect (have lost) को Past Perfect (had lost) में बदलें।
trick: Exclamatory words (Alas, Hurrah) Indirect speech में हटा दिए जाते हैं और उनके भाव को Reporting verb में शामिल किया जाता है।
tip: Alas के लिए 'exclaimed with sorrow' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The traveler said to the policeman, 'Can you tell me the way to the nearest hotel?'
options: The traveler asked the policeman if he could tell him the way to the nearest hotel.
The traveler requested the policeman if he can tell him the way to the nearest hotel.
The traveler asked the policeman whether could he tell him the way to the nearest hotel.
The traveler asked the policeman that if he could tell him the way to the nearest hotel.
answer: The traveler asked the policeman if he could tell him the way to the nearest hotel.
explanation: चरण 1: Yes/No प्रश्न होने के कारण 'asked' और conjunction 'if' या 'whether' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'that' और 'if' एक साथ कभी नहीं आते। चरण 3: 'Can' को 'could' में बदलें। चरण 4: वाक्य को Assertive बनाएँ (he could)।
trick: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' conjunction का प्रयोग एक बहुत ही सामान्य फँसाने वाला विकल्प (trap) है।
tip: Yes/No वाले प्रश्नों में केवल if/whether लगाएँ, that नहीं।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'Let us go out for a dinner tonight.'
options: He proposed me that we should go out for a dinner that night.
He proposed to me that we should go out for a dinner that night.
He suggested to me that they should go out for a dinner tonight.
He suggested me to go out for a dinner that night.
answer: He proposed to me that we should go out for a dinner that night.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let us' वाले वाक्यों में 'proposed to' या 'suggested to' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: Conjunction 'that' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'us' को 'we' (चूंकि listener 'me' है) में बदलें और 'should + V1' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'tonight' को 'that night' में बदलें।
trick: 'suggested/proposed' के बाद यदि object (me) हो, तो 'to' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है (suggested to me)।
tip: Let us वाले वाक्यों में subject + should का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The teacher said to the students, 'The Earth revolves around the Sun.'
options: The teacher told the students that the Earth revolved around the Sun.
The teacher asked the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
The teacher told the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
The teacher told the students the Earth revolves around the Sun.
answer: The teacher told the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'told' में बदलें। चरण 2: Conjunction 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 3: चूँकि Reported Speech एक Universal Truth (सार्वभौमिक सत्य) है, इसलिए इसके Tense (revolves) में कोई बदलाव नहीं होगा।
trick: Reporting verb पास्ट में होने के बावजूद, यूनिवर्सल ट्रुथ का टेन्स कभी नहीं बदलता।
tip: Universal Truth का Tense हमेशा अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: My boss said to me, 'You must finish this project by tomorrow.'
options: My boss ordered me that I must finish that project by the next day.
My boss told me that I had to finish that project by the next day.
My boss advised me that I must finish this project by tomorrow.
My boss told me that I must have finished that project by the next day.
answer: My boss told me that I had to finish that project by the next day.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'told' या 'ordered' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'this' को 'that' और 'tomorrow' को 'the next day' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'must' जब अनिवार्यता (compulsion) दर्शाता है, तो Indirect Speech में इसे 'had to' में बदल दिया जाता है।
trick: वर्तमान या भविष्य की मजबूरी/अनिवार्यता के लिए 'must' को 'had to' में बदलना SSC/IBPS का पसंदीदा नियम है।
tip: Compulsion दर्शाने वाले 'must' को 'had to' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said, 'What a beautiful dress you are wearing!'
options: She exclaimed that I was wearing a very beautiful dress.
She exclaimed with joy that what a beautiful dress I was wearing.
She exclaimed that I am wearing a very beautiful dress.
She asked me what a beautiful dress I was wearing.
answer: She exclaimed that I was wearing a very beautiful dress.
explanation: चरण 1: 'What a' वाले Exclamatory वाक्य को Assertive में बदलें। चरण 2: 'What a' को हटाकर adjective से पहले 'very' या 'great' लगाएँ। चरण 3: Present Continuous (are wearing) को Past Continuous (was wearing) में बदलें।
trick: 'What' या 'How' से शुरू होने वाले विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यों में 'very' का प्रयोग करके उसे साधारण वाक्य बनाया जाता है।
tip: Exclamatory 'What a' को 'very' में बदलकर वाक्य साधारण बनाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The old man said to his sons, 'Do not quarrel among yourselves.'
options: The old man forbade his sons to not quarrel among themselves.
The old man forbade his sons from quarreling among themselves.
The old man advised his sons not to quarrel among themselves.
Both (b) and (c) are correct.
answer: The old man advised his sons not to quarrel among themselves.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'advised' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'Do not' को 'not to' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'yourselves' (Second Person Plural) को 'sons' के अनुसार 'themselves' में बदलें। ध्यान दें: यदि 'forbade' का प्रयोग होता, तो 'not' नहीं आता (forbade his sons to quarrel)।
trick: 'forbade' के साथ 'not' का प्रयोग सुपरफ्लुअस (अनावश्यक) है। इसलिए विकल्प (a) गलत है।
tip: Forbade के साथ कभी भी 'not' का प्रयोग न करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The passenger said, 'Will the train arrive on time?'
options: The passenger enquired if the train would arrive on time.
The passenger enquired whether the train will arrive on time.
The passenger asked if the train would arrived on time.
The passenger enquired that if the train would arrive on time.
answer: The passenger enquired if the train would arrive on time.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said' को 'enquired' या 'asked' में बदलें। चरण 2: Yes/No प्रश्न के लिए 'if' या 'whether' लगाएँ। चरण 3: 'Will' को 'would' में बदलें। चरण 4: Modal (would) के बाद हमेशा V1 (arrive) का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: Modal verb (would, could, should) के बाद हमेशा Verb की First Form (V1) आती है।
tip: Will को would में बदलें और V1 का ही प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'Good morning! How are you doing today?'
options: He wished me good morning and asked how was I doing that day.
He wished me good morning and asked how I was doing that day.
He bade me good morning and asked how I am doing today.
He wished me good morning and asked that how I was doing that day.
answer: He wished me good morning and asked how I was doing that day.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Good morning' के लिए 'wished' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: दूसरे हिस्से (प्रश्न) के लिए 'and asked' से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'How are you' को 'how I was' (Assertive) में बदलें। चरण 4: 'today' को 'that day' में बदलें।
trick: एक ही वाक्य में Wish और Question दोनों हों, तो Reporting Verb को दो हिस्सों में बाँटना पड़ता है (wished and asked)।
tip: Greeting के लिए Wished और प्रश्न के लिए Asked का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The Captain said to the soldiers, 'Stand at ease!'
options: The Captain ordered the soldiers to stand at ease.
The Captain commanded the soldiers to stand at ease.
Both (a) and (b) are correct.
The Captain requested the soldiers to stand at ease.
answer: Both (a) and (b) are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: सेना या पुलिस के संदर्भ में आदेश के लिए 'ordered' या 'commanded' दोनों का प्रयोग सही है। चरण 2: Imperative वाक्य को जोड़ने के लिए 'to + V1' (to stand) का प्रयोग करें।
trick: Commanded और Ordered दोनों सैन्य आदेशों के लिए मान्य हैं, इसलिए 'Both' वाला विकल्प सही है।
tip: सैन्य आदेशों के लिए Commanded या Ordered का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The girl said, 'Oh! I have spilled tea on my new laptop.'
options: The girl exclaimed with regret that she had spilled tea on her new laptop.
The girl exclaimed with joy that she had spilled tea on her new laptop.
The girl told with sorrow that she spilled tea on her new laptop.
The girl exclaimed with regret that she has spilled tea on her new laptop.
answer: The girl exclaimed with regret that she had spilled tea on her new laptop.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Oh!' गलती या नुकसान दर्शाता है, इसलिए 'exclaimed with regret/sorrow' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'have spilled' (Present Perfect) को 'had spilled' (Past Perfect) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'she' और 'my' को 'her' में बदलें।
trick: Exclamatory वाक्यों में 'told' का प्रयोग गलत होता है, हमेशा 'exclaimed' का प्रयोग करें।
tip: Oh! के लिए exclaimed with regret/sorrow का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to his friend, 'Please lend me your car for a day.'
options: He ordered his friend to lend him his car for a day.
He requested his friend to lend him his car for a day.
He asked his friend to kindly lend him his car for a day.
He requested his friend that he should lend him his car for a day.
answer: He requested his friend to lend him his car for a day.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Please' को हटाकर Reporting verb को 'requested' में बदलें। चरण 2: Imperative वाक्य को 'to + V1' (to lend) से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'me' को 'him' (He के अनुसार) और 'your' को 'his' (friend के अनुसार) में बदलें।
trick: Indirect speech में 'requested' के साथ 'please' या 'kindly' का प्रयोग करना redundancy (अनावश्यक दोहराव) है।
tip: Requested के साथ Please या Kindly का प्रयोग कभी न करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said, 'If I were a bird, I would fly to you.'
options: She said that if she was a bird, she would fly to him.
She said that if she were a bird, she would have flown to me.
She said that if she were a bird, she would fly to me.
She said that if she had been a bird, she would fly to me.
answer: She said that if she were a bird, she would fly to me.
explanation: चरण 1: यह एक 'Unreal/Imaginary Condition' (काल्पनिक स्थिति) है। चरण 2: काल्पनिक स्थितियों में 'were' और 'would' का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता है। चरण 3: Pronouns (I -> she, you -> me/him) बदलेंगे।
trick: काल्पनिक वाक्यों (If I were...) का Tense कभी नहीं बदलता है, यह एक महत्वपूर्ण अपवाद (exception) है।
tip: काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Unreal past) का Tense अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'I need not go to the office tomorrow.'
options: He said that he did not need to go to the office the next day.
He said that he needn't go to the office the next day.
He said that he would not need to go to the office tomorrow.
He said that he must not go to the office the next day.
answer: He said that he needn't go to the office the next day.
explanation: चरण 1: Modal 'need not' (या needn't) Indirect Speech में सामान्यतः अपरिवर्तित रहता है। चरण 2: 'tomorrow' को 'the next day' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें।
trick: 'Need not' और 'Dare not' को Indirect Speech में Tense के अनुसार नहीं बदला जाता है।
tip: Need not और Dare not का Tense न बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The judge said to the witness, 'Tell the truth or face the consequences.'
options: The judge warned the witness to tell the truth or face the consequences.
The judge ordered the witness that he should tell the truth or face the consequences.
The judge asked the witness to tell the truth or face the consequences.
The judge warned the witness to tell the truth and face the consequences.
answer: The judge warned the witness to tell the truth or face the consequences.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य के भाव (धमकी/चेतावनी) को समझें और 'warned' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Imperative वाक्य को 'to + V1' (to tell) से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'or face the consequences' को यथावत रखें।
trick: 'or face the consequences' एक स्पष्ट चेतावनी है, इसलिए 'warned' सबसे उपयुक्त Reporting Verb है।
tip: चेतावनी वाले Imperative वाक्यों में Warned का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: 'Who is the culprit?' asked the King.
options: The King asked who the culprit was.
The King asked who was the culprit.
The King asked that who the culprit was.
The King asked who the culprit is.
answer: The King asked who the culprit was.
explanation: चरण 1: Reporting verb 'asked' को शुरू में लाएँ। चरण 2: Wh- word 'who' को conjunction बनाएँ। चरण 3: वाक्य को Assertive बनाएँ, यानी helping verb (is -> was) को subject (the culprit) के बाद रखें।
trick: हमेशा Subject + Verb का क्रम याद रखें (who the culprit was)। 'who was the culprit' गलत है।
tip: प्रश्नवाचक से साधारण बनाते समय Subject के बाद Verb लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: My father said to me, 'May you succeed in all your endeavors!'
options: My father wished that I might succeed in all my endeavors.
My father prayed that I may succeed in all my endeavors.
My father wished me that I might succeed in all my endeavors.
My father blessed me that I might succeed in all my endeavors.
answer: My father wished that I might succeed in all my endeavors.
explanation: चरण 1: Optative sentence (इच्छावाचक) में 'said to' को 'wished' या 'prayed' में बदलें। चरण 2: Conjunction 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 3: 'May' को subject (I) के बाद 'might' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'your' को 'my' में बदलें।
trick: Wished/Prayed के बाद सीधे Object (me) का प्रयोग सामान्यतः नहीं किया जाता है (wished me that... गलत है)।
tip: Optative वाक्यों में Wished/Prayed के साथ that + Sub + might लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'Bravo! You have done a splendid job.'
options: He applauded him saying that he had done a splendid job.
He exclaimed with joy that I had done a splendid job.
He applauded that you have done a splendid job.
He praised me saying that I have done a splendid job.
answer: He applauded him saying that he had done a splendid job.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Bravo!' प्रशंसा (Applause) दर्शाता है, इसलिए 'applauded + object + saying' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: 'have done' (Present Perfect) को 'had done' (Past Perfect) में बदलें। चरण 3: Pronouns को उपयुक्त रूप से बदलें।
trick: 'Bravo' के लिए सबसे सटीक संरचना 'applauded + object + saying + that' होती है।
tip: Bravo के लिए हमेशा 'applauded ... saying' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to him, 'Why don't you apply for this job?'
options: She asked him why he didn't apply for that job.
She suggested him to apply for that job.
She asked him why didn't he apply for that job.
She advised him why he did not apply for this job.
answer: She asked him why he didn't apply for that job.
explanation: चरण 1: Wh- question होने पर 'asked' और conjunction 'why' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'don't' (Present) को 'didn't' (Past) में बदलें। चरण 3: वाक्य को Assertive (he didn't apply) बनाएँ। चरण 4: 'this' को 'that' में बदलें। (नोट: यह सुझाव भी हो सकता है, लेकिन संरचना के अनुसार विकल्प A सही है)।
trick: यद्यपि 'Why don't you' एक सुझाव जैसा लगता है, व्याकरणिक रूप से इसे प्रश्न की तरह ही (asked) हल किया जाता है।
tip: Why don't you को why he/she didn't में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The child said, 'Mom, I am very hungry.'
options: The child told his mom that he was very hungry.
The child said to his mom that I am very hungry.
The child told that mom he was very hungry.
The child asked his mom if he was very hungry.
answer: The child told his mom that he was very hungry.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Mom' यहाँ Vocative case (संबोधन) है। Indirect Speech में इसे Reporting verb का Object बना लें (told his mom)। चरण 2: 'am' को 'was' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें।
trick: Vocative case (जैसे- Mom, Sir, Friends) को हमेशा Reporting Verb का Object (told/addressed as) बना दिया जाता है।
tip: Vocative शब्दों को Reporting Verb का Object बना दें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'I have been studying since morning.'
options: He said that he had been studying since morning.
He said that he has been studying since morning.
He said that he was studying since morning.
He told that he had been studying since morning.
answer: He said that he had been studying since morning.
explanation: चरण 1: Present Perfect Continuous (have been studying) को Past Perfect Continuous (had been studying) में बदलें। चरण 2: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'said' के बाद object न होने पर उसे 'said' ही रहने दें, 'told' में न बदलें।
trick: बिना Object के 'said' को 'told' में बदलना एक सामान्य गलती है।
tip: बिना Object के Said को Told में न बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The policeman said to the driver, 'Show me your license.'
options: The policeman ordered the driver to show him his license.
The policeman requested the driver to show him his license.
The policeman asked the driver that he should show him his license.
The policeman ordered the driver that show him his license.
answer: The policeman ordered the driver to show him his license.
explanation: चरण 1: पुलिस का निर्देश सामान्यतः 'order' होता है, इसलिए 'ordered' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Imperative वाक्य को 'to + V1' (to show) से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'me' को 'him' (policeman) और 'your' को 'his' (driver) में बदलें।
trick: Imperative वाक्यों में 'that' conjunction का प्रयोग नहीं होता, हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
tip: Imperative वाक्यों को 'to + V1' से जोड़ें, that से नहीं।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The teacher said, 'Boys, turn to page 50.'
options: The teacher asked the boys to turn to page 50.
The teacher told the boys to turn to page 50.
The teacher ordered the boys to turn to page 50.
All of the above are acceptable depending on the tone.
answer: All of the above are acceptable depending on the tone.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Boys' (Vocative Case) Object बन जाएगा। चरण 2: Imperative वाक्य 'to turn' से जुड़ेगा। चरण 3: शिक्षक का निर्देश asked (कहना), told (बताना), या ordered (आदेश) तीनों हो सकता है, जो विकल्पों पर निर्भर करता है। SSC/IBPS ऐसे मामलों में All of the above या सबसे सटीक (ordered/asked) देता है।
trick: Imperative वाक्यों में 'asked' का अर्थ 'पूछना' नहीं बल्कि 'कहना' (ask to do something) होता है, जो पूरी तरह सही है।
tip: Imperative में asked का अर्थ 'कोई काम करने को कहना' होता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: Rahul said to me, 'I will meet you here tomorrow.'
options: Rahul told me that he would meet me there the next day.
Rahul told me that he will meet me here the next day.
Rahul told me that he would meet me here tomorrow.
Rahul told me that I would meet him there the next day.
answer: Rahul told me that he would meet me there the next day.
explanation: चरण 1: 'said to' को 'told' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'will' को 'would' में बदलें। चरण 3: Time/Place words: 'here' को 'there' और 'tomorrow' को 'the next day' में बदलें। चरण 4: Pronouns: 'I' -> 'he', 'you' -> 'me'।
trick: Tense, Pronoun, और Time/Place - इन तीनों पैमानों पर बदलाव जाँचना जरूरी है। एक भी छूटने पर उत्तर गलत हो जाएगा।
tip: हमेशा Tense, Pronoun और Time words तीनों में बदलाव जाँचें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to her brother, 'Don't you know the answer?'
options: She asked her brother if he did not know the answer.
She asked her brother why he did not know the answer.
She asked her brother that if he did not know the answer.
She asked her brother if he don't know the answer.
answer: She asked her brother if he did not know the answer.
explanation: चरण 1: Yes/No प्रश्न है, 'asked' और 'if' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Negative Interrogative (Don't you know) को Assertive Negative (he did not know) में बदलें। चरण 3: Present (do) को Past (did) में बदलें।
trick: 'Don't you' देखकर इसे Wh- question समझने की भूल न करें; यह 'Do not you' (Yes/No प्रश्न) है।
tip: Negative Yes/No प्रश्नों को if + Sub + did not में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: 'Let there be no misunderstanding between us,' said the partners.
options: The partners proposed that there should be no misunderstanding between them.
The partners ordered that there should be no misunderstanding between us.
The partners wished that there be no misunderstanding between them.
The partners said that let there be no misunderstanding between them.
answer: The partners proposed that there should be no misunderstanding between them.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let there be' वाले वाक्यों में 'proposed' या 'suggested' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: Conjunction 'that' लगाएँ। चरण 3: 'there should be' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'us' को 'them' में बदलें।
trick: 'Let there be' हमेशा 'that there should be' में परिवर्तित होता है।
tip: Let there be को that there should be में बदलें।

question: Select the correct direct form of the given indirect sentence: The commander ordered the soldiers to march forward and attack the enemy camp.
options: The commander said to the soldiers, 'March forward and attack the enemy camp.'
The commander says to the soldiers, 'March forward and attack the enemy camp.'
The commander said to the soldiers, 'You must march forward and attack the enemy camp.'
The commander ordered the soldiers, 'To march forward and attack the enemy camp.'
answer: The commander said to the soldiers, 'March forward and attack the enemy camp.'
explanation: चरण 1: Indirect से Direct बनाते समय 'ordered' को 'said to' में बदलें। चरण 2: Inverted commas (' ') का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'to march' को Imperative verb 'March' में बदलें और बाकी वाक्य यथावत रखें।
trick: Reverse conversion में 'ordered' को 'said to' में और 'to + V1' को सीधे 'V1' (Imperative) में बदला जाता है।
tip: Indirect से Direct बनाते समय 'to V1' को 'V1' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'You are coming to the party, aren't you?'
options: He asked me if I was going to the party.
He asked me if I was coming to the party.
He asked me that if I was coming to the party.
He asked me if I am coming to the party.
answer: He asked me if I was coming to the party.
explanation: चरण 1: Question Tag (aren't you?) वाले वाक्यों को Indirect Speech में सामान्य Yes/No प्रश्नों (asked + if) की तरह हल किया जाता है। चरण 2: Tag को पूरी तरह हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 3: 'are coming' को 'was coming' में बदलें। (नोट: come को go में बदलना अनिवार्य नहीं है, संदर्भ पर निर्भर करता है)।
trick: Question Tags (isn't it, aren't you) Indirect Speech में पूरी तरह से विलुप्त (drop) हो जाते हैं।
tip: Question Tags को हटा दें और सामान्य if/whether नियम लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said, 'Yes, I broke the expensive vase.'
options: She admitted that she had broken the expensive vase.
She replied in the affirmative and said that she had broken the expensive vase.
Both (a) and (b) are correct.
She said yes that she broke the expensive vase.
answer: Both (a) and (b) are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Yes' वाले उत्तरों को 'replied in the affirmative' या सीधे 'admitted/agreed' से दर्शाया जा सकता है। चरण 2: 'broke' (Past Indefinite) को 'had broken' (Past Perfect) में बदलें।
trick: आधुनिक ग्रामर में 'replied in the affirmative' के बजाय सीधे 'admitted' या 'agreed' का प्रयोग अधिक स्वाभाविक माना जाता है, पर दोनों सही हैं।
tip: Yes के लिए 'admitted' या 'replied in the affirmative' चुनें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The monk said, 'Death is the ultimate truth of life.'
options: The monk said that death was the ultimate truth of life.
The monk said that death is the ultimate truth of life.
The monk told that death is the ultimate truth of life.
The monk exclaimed that death is the ultimate truth of life.
answer: The monk said that death is the ultimate truth of life.
explanation: चरण 1: यह वाक्य एक दार्शनिक/सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Philosophical/Universal truth) है। चरण 2: ऐसे वाक्यों का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता (is का is ही रहेगा)। चरण 3: 'said' के बाद object न होने पर 'said' ही रखें।
trick: Universal truth या Proverbs (कहावतों) के Tense में कोई बदलाव नहीं होता। 'was' वाला विकल्प एक ट्रैप है।
tip: दार्शनिक या सार्वभौमिक सत्य का Tense अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'What a fool I have been!'
options: He exclaimed with regret that he had been a great fool.
He exclaimed with sorrow that what a fool he had been.
He confessed that he was a great fool.
He exclaimed that he has been a great fool.
answer: He exclaimed with regret that he had been a great fool.
explanation: चरण 1: 'What a' वाले Exclamatory वाक्य को Assertive बनाएँ। 'What a fool' -> 'a great fool'। चरण 2: Present Perfect (have been) को Past Perfect (had been) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'exclaimed with regret' (पछतावा) का प्रयोग करें।
trick: Noun (fool) से पहले 'great' और Adjective (beautiful) से पहले 'very' का प्रयोग होता है (great fool / very beautiful)।
tip: Noun से पहले 'great' और Adjective से पहले 'very' लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The principal said to the peon, 'Let the visitors come in.'
options: The principal ordered the peon to let the visitors come in.

explanation: चरण 1: जब 'Let' आज्ञा (allow) का अर्थ दे (suggest का नहीं), तो Reporting Verb 'ordered/asked' में बदलता है। चरण 2: वाक्य को 'to + let + V1' (to let the visitors come in) से जोड़ें।
trick: यहाँ 'Let' का अर्थ 'allow' है, प्रस्ताव नहीं। इसलिए 'proposed' या 'should' का प्रयोग गलत है।
tip: जब Let = Allow हो, तो 'to let' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said, 'I had completed my assignment before the guests arrived.'

She said that she had been completing her assignment before the guests arrived.
answer: She said that she had completed her assignment before the guests had arrived.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में दो Clause हैं। Past Perfect (had completed) नहीं बदलता है। चरण 2: Past Indefinite (arrived) को Past Perfect (had arrived) में बदल दिया जाता है। (हालांकि आधुनिक अंग्रेजी में इसे अपरिवर्तित भी रखा जा सकता है, लेकिन SSC 'had arrived' को प्राथमिकता देता है)।
trick: Time clause (before/after) वाले Past Indefinite वाक्यों को अक्सर Past Perfect में बदल दिया जाता है।
tip: Past Perfect Tense कभी नहीं बदलता (No Tense Change)।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The interviewer said to the candidate, 'Please have a seat and tell me about yourself.'

The interviewer ordered the candidate to have a seat and tell him about himself.
The interviewer asked the candidate kindly to have a seat and tell him about himself.

explanation: चरण 1: 'Please' के लिए 'requested' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: दो Imperative verbs (have, tell) 'and' से जुड़े हैं। पहले Verb के साथ 'to' (to have) लगता है, दूसरे के साथ 'to' लगाना आवश्यक नहीं है। चरण 3: Pronouns (me->him, yourself->himself) बदलें।
trick: 'and' से जुड़ने वाले दो Infinitives में दूसरे Infinitive से पहले 'to' को छिपा (omit) दिया जाता है।
tip: And से जुड़े दो verbs में केवल पहले के साथ 'to' लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'By God! I have never seen such a terrible accident.'

trick: 'By God', 'By Heaven' आदि शपथ (Oath) दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए 'swore' (swear का past) का प्रयोग सबसे सटीक है।
tip: By God/Heaven के लिए 'swore by God/Heaven' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The little girl said, 'Mother, where are my toys?'

trick: 'where were her toys' एक Interrogative संरचना है, जो Indirect Speech में पूर्णतः गलत है।
tip: Wh-word + Subject + Verb का क्रम हमेशा याद रखें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to her boss, 'Sir, may I leave early today?'

trick: Indirect Speech में 'Sir/Madam' शब्द हटा दिए जाते हैं और उनकी जगह Reporting Verb के साथ 'respectfully' जोड़ दिया जाता है।
tip: Sir/Madam को हटाकर respectfully का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct direct form of the given indirect sentence: The astronomer explained that the stars are incredibly far away from us.

explanation: चरण 1: 'explained that' को 'said,' में बदलें। चरण 2: तारों की दूरी एक वैज्ञानिक सत्य (Scientific truth) है, इसलिए Direct speech में भी 'are' ही रहेगा।
trick: Universal/Scientific Truths का Tense Direct से Indirect और Indirect से Direct दोनों में अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
tip: वैज्ञानिक सत्य का Tense Direct Speech में भी नहीं बदलता।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'Wait here till I return.'

He asked me to wait there till he returns.

trick: वाक्य में Imperative और Assertive दोनों हिस्से हैं। दोनों के नियम (to + V1 और Tense change) एक साथ लागू होंगे।
tip: जुड़े हुए Clause (till/when) का Tense बदलना न भूलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The client said, 'I had a meeting with the CEO yesterday.'

explanation: चरण 1: 'had' यहाँ Main Verb (Past Indefinite) है जिसका अर्थ 'किया' या 'रखा' है। चरण 2: Past Indefinite को Past Perfect (had + V3) में बदला जाता है। चरण 3: 'had' की V3 भी 'had' होती है, इसलिए 'had had' का प्रयोग होगा।
trick: 'had had' देखने में अजीब लगता है, लेकिन Past Perfect में Helping Verb (had) और Main Verb (had) दोनों एक साथ आते हैं।
tip: Past Indefinite के 'had' को 'had had' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: Ravi said, 'Wow! This is a masterpiece.'

trick: 'that that' एक साथ देखकर घबराएँ नहीं। पहला 'that' जोड़ने के लिए है, और दूसरा 'that' 'this' का बदला हुआ रूप है।
tip: This को that में बदलने से 'that that' एक साथ आ सकता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: My mother said to me, 'Did you lock the front door?'

trick: Past Indefinite (Did + V1) को हमेशा Past Perfect (had + V3) में बदलें।
tip: Did + V1 को had + V3 में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The politician said, 'I will not tolerate corruption in my department.'
options: The politician declared that he would not tolerate corruption in his department.
The politician said that I will not tolerate corruption in my department.
The politician told that he would not tolerate corruption in his department.
The politician declared that he will not tolerate corruption in his department.
answer: The politician declared that he would not tolerate corruption in his department.
explanation: चरण 1: दृढ़ संकल्प या आधिकारिक बयान के लिए 'declared' या 'stated' एक अच्छा Reporting Verb है। चरण 2: 'will' को 'would' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'he' और 'my' को 'his' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: 'Could you please open the window?' she said to him.
options: She requested him to open the window.

She ordered him to open the window.
She requested him that he could open the window.
answer: She requested him to open the window.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Could you please' प्रश्न नहीं, बल्कि एक विनम्र निवेदन (Polite Request) है। चरण 2: इसे Interrogative (if/whether) के बजाय Imperative (requested + to + V1) की तरह हल किया जाता है। चरण 3: 'Could you please' को हटाकर सीधे 'to open' लिखें।
trick: 'Could/Would you please' वाले वाक्य विनम्र निवेदन होते हैं, इन्हें 'if' से जोड़ने के बजाय 'requested to' से जोड़ें।
tip: Could you please को हटाकर 'requested to + V1' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'Need I write this essay again?'
options: He asked if he had to write that essay again.
He asked if he needed to write that essay again.

He asked if he need write this essay again.
answer: Both (a) and (b) are acceptable.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Need I' (प्रश्नवाचक) को Indirect में बदलते समय 'had to' या 'needed to' में बदला जा सकता है। चरण 2: 'this' को 'that' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'if' लगाकर वाक्य को Assertive (he had to / he needed to) बनाएँ।
trick: 'Need' जब Interrogative Modal हो, तो पास्ट में यह 'had to' या 'needed to' बन जाता है। (Need not अपरिवर्तित रहता है, लेकिन प्रश्नवाचक Need बदलता है)।
tip: प्रश्नवाचक Need को had to या needed to में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to her friend, 'Farewell! We will meet again.'
options: She bade her friend farewell and said that they would meet again.

She bade her friend farewell and said that they will meet again.
She told her friend farewell and that they would meet again.

explanation: चरण 1: विदाई (Farewell, Good bye, Good night) के लिए Reporting verb 'bade' (bid का past) का प्रयोग किया जाता है। चरण 2: अगले वाक्य को 'and said that' से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'We' को 'they' में और 'will' को 'would' में बदलें।
trick: 'wished' का प्रयोग Good morning आदि के लिए होता है, जबकि विदाई के लिए हमेशा 'bade' (अलविदा कहना) का प्रयोग होता है।
tip: Farewell/Goodbye के लिए हमेशा Bade का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The beggar said, 'If only I had some money!'
options: The beggar wished that he had some money.
The beggar exclaimed with sorrow that he has some money.

The beggar prayed that if only he had some money.
answer: The beggar wished that he had some money.
explanation: चरण 1: 'If only' या 'O that' जैसी संरचनाएँ प्रबल इच्छा (Strong Wish) दर्शाती हैं। चरण 2: Reporting Verb को 'wished' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'If only' को हटा दें और 'had' (Past) को अपरिवर्तित रखें (क्योंकि यह Unreal Past है)।
trick: 'If only' को 'wished that' में बदला जाता है और Unreal Past का Tense नहीं बदलता।
tip: If only वाले वाक्यों में Wished का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct direct form of the given indirect sentence: The boy denied having stolen the watch.
options: The boy said, 'I did not steal the watch.'

answer: All of the above.
explanation: चरण 1: 'denied having stolen' (चोरी करने से इंकार किया) एक Advanced Indirect संरचना है। चरण 2: यह 'I did not steal', 'I have not stolen', या 'No, I didn't' तीनों के लिए एक समान और संक्षिप्त Indirect रूप है।
trick: 'denied + V-ing' (Gerund) का प्रयोग किसी भी Past Negative Assertion (I didn't / I haven't) के लिए किया जा सकता है।
tip: Denied + V-ing सभी Past Negative Statements के लिए मान्य है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The interviewer said to the candidate, 'Will you be able to join us by next Monday?'
options: The interviewer asked the candidate if he would be able to join them by the following Monday.

answer: The interviewer asked the candidate if he would be able to join them by the following Monday.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Will you' एक Yes/No प्रश्न है, इसलिए 'asked' और 'if/whether' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'Will' को 'would' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'next Monday' को 'the following Monday' में और 'us' को 'them' में बदलें।
trick: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' conjunction का प्रयोग कभी नहीं होता। विकल्प C में 'that if' है जो गलत है।
tip: Yes/No प्रश्नों में 'that' के बजाय केवल 'if/whether' लगाएँ।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'What a pleasant surprise to see you here today!'

explanation: चरण 1: 'What a pleasant surprise' विस्मय (Exclamation) दर्शाता है, इसलिए 'exclaimed' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'here' को 'there' और 'today' को 'that day' में बदलें। चरण 3: वाक्य को Assertive (it was) बनाएँ।
trick: 'What a' वाले Exclamatory वाक्यों को Indirect में Assertive (साधारण वाक्य) बनाया जाता है।
tip: Exclamatory वाक्यों को Assertive बनाएँ और Time words बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The doctor said to the patient, 'Do not skip your medicines if you want to recover fast.'
options: The doctor advised the patient not to skip his medicines if he wanted to recover fast.
The doctor advised the patient to not skip his medicines if he wanted to recover fast.

The doctor advised the patient that he should not skip his medicines if he want to recover fast.
answer: The doctor advised the patient not to skip his medicines if he wanted to recover fast.
explanation: चरण 1: सलाह के लिए 'advised' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Negative Imperative (Do not) को 'not to + V1' (not to skip) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'want' (Present) को 'wanted' (Past) में बदलें।
trick: 'to not skip' एक split infinitive है जो व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है, 'not to skip' सही है।
tip: Negative Imperative में हमेशा 'not to' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to her friend, 'Let us go for a long drive this evening.'

trick: 'proposed' या 'suggested' के बाद Object होने पर 'to' लगाना अनिवार्य है (proposed to her friend)।
tip: 'Let us' को 'that they/we should' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: My mother said, 'The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.'

trick: रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब Past (said) में होने के बावजूद, सत्य तथ्यों का Tense अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The principal said to the students, 'Why are you making so much noise?'

tip: Wh-word के तुरंत बाद Subject का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'You must leave the premises immediately.'

trick: 'must' को 'had to' में बदलना SSC परीक्षाओं का एक बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण नियम है।
tip: Compulsion (अनिवार्यता) वाले 'must' को 'had to' में बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The tourist said, 'Wow! How magnificent the Taj Mahal looks in the moonlight!'

trick: विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यों में 'How' या 'What' को हटाकर 'very' या 'great' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
tip: 'How' को हटाकर 'very' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: She said to her brother, 'Please help me sort out these files today.'

trick: Indirect speech में 'requested' के साथ 'please' का प्रयोग redundancy (अनावश्यक) है।
tip: Requested के साथ Please का प्रयोग न करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The old man said, 'If I were young again, I would travel the whole world.'

trick: काल्पनिक स्थितियों (If I were) का Tense कभी नहीं बदलता, इसे 'was' या 'had been' करना गलत है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said to me, 'I need not go to the bank tomorrow.'

trick: 'Need not' और 'Dare not' को Tense के नियमानुसार नहीं बदला जाता, वे अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The commander said to the soldiers, 'Stand at ease!'

trick: सैन्य बलों में दिए गए निर्देश हमेशा 'Order' या 'Command' होते हैं।
tip: सैन्य निर्देशों के लिए हमेशा Ordered या Commanded चुनें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The girl said, 'Alas! I have lost my expensive smartphone.'

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: Rahul asked me, 'Where did you buy this wonderful jacket from?'

tip: Subject के बाद Verb लगाएँ और Tense बदलें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: My father said to me, 'May God shower his choicest blessings on you!'

trick: 'prayed' या 'wished' के बाद सीधे Object (me) का प्रयोग नहीं होता है।
tip: Optative में 'that + Subject + might' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: He said, 'Bravo! You have played an excellent inning today.'

trick: Bravo वाले वाक्यों की सबसे सटीक Indirect संरचना 'applauded... saying' होती है।

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence: The manager said to his assistant, 'Call the client right now and cancel the meeting.'

question: Select the correct direct form of the given indirect sentence: The old woman asked the stranger if he could help her cross the busy street.
